name: termenbox-native
description: Optional iOS, Android and desktop wrappers for the Termenbox client

scripts.sync: node scripts/build-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-bridge.mjs && cap sync && node scripts/inject-bridge.mjs android ios
scripts.sync:android: node scripts/build-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-bridge.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/inject-bridge.mjs android
scripts.sync:ios: node scripts/build-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-bridge.mjs && cap sync ios && node scripts/inject-bridge.mjs ios
